summary: V1 Stabilization testing complete. All 7 tabs accessible (Reader, TOC, Surgeon View, NoteLab, Study, Syllabus, PDRM). Global zoom controls work and sync between Reader/Surgeon views. PDRM tab shows empty state with 'Open Surgeon View' button. TOC tab shows 'Add Chapter Manually' when no TOC detected. Surgeon View has Auto/Manual PDRM toggle and Clean/Full/PDF mode toggle. No UI leaking between tabs - strict mode separation verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Global zoom store (zoomStore.ts) correctly persists zoom level to localStorage
PureReaderView uses global zoom store for shared zoom across views
PureSurgeonView has Auto/Manual toggle (data-testid='pdrm-auto-toggle') and Clean/Full/PDF mode buttons
PurePdrmView shows empty state with 'Open Surgeon View' button when no entries
PureTocView shows 'Add Chapter Manually' button when no TOC detected
All 7 tabs have proper mode separation - no UI elements leaking between views
context_for_next_testing_agent: V1 stabilization features verified: 7-tab navigation, global zoom, PDRM tab, Auto/Manual toggle, Clean/Full/PDF mode toggle, TOC navigation buttons. Firebase is MOCKED - using localStorage via Zustand persist middleware.

global_zoom_controls.details: Zoom buttons (-/+/reset) appear in top bar when PDF loaded. Zoom syncs between Reader and Surgeon View (125% -> 150% -> 100% -> 125%)

pdrm_tab_empty_state.details: Shows 'No PDRM Entries Yet' with 'Open Surgeon View' button that navigates to Surgeon View

surgeon_view_auto_manual_toggle.details: Auto/Manual PDRM toggle found via data-testid='pdrm-auto-toggle'

toc_add_chapter_manually.details: Shows '+ Add Chapter Manually' button when no TOC detected

toc_navigation_buttons.details: 'Open in Reader' and 'Open in Surgeon' buttons found

mode_separation.details: No UI leaking between tabs - Reader doesn't show Surgeon elements, each tab has its own distinct UI

mocked_integrations.firebase: MOCKED - using localStorage for persistence via Zustand persist middleware
